# pve_sdn_fabrics (Data Source)

SDN fabric inventory: endpoint index, all configured fabrics, and the fabric node configurations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_sdn_fabrics" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `pending` (Boolean) Display pending config.
- `running` (Boolean) Display running config.

### Read-Only

- `fabrics` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fabrics))
- `id` (String) Identifier: .
- `index` (Attributes List) Returned by /cluster/sdn/fabrics. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--index))
- `nodes` (Attributes List) Returned by /cluster/sdn/fabrics/node. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))

<a id="nestedatt--fabrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fabrics`

Read-Only:

- `api_id` (String) Identifier for SDN fabrics
- `area` (String) OSPF area. Either a IPv4 address or a 32-bit number. Gets validated in rust.
- `csnp_interval` (Number) The csnp_interval property for Openfabric
- `digest` (String) Prevent changes if current configuration file has a different digest. This can be used to prevent concurrent modifications.
- `hello_interval` (Number) The hello_interval property for Openfabric
- `ip6_prefix` (String) The IP prefix for Node IPs
- `ip_prefix` (String) The IP prefix for Node IPs
- `lock_token` (String) the token for unlocking the global SDN configuration
- `persistent_keepalive` (Number) A seconds interval, between 1 and 65535 inclusive, of how often to send an authenticated empty packet to the peer for the purpose of keeping a stateful firewall or NAT mapping valid persistently. For example, if the interface very rarely sends traffic, but it might at anytime receive traffic from another node, and it is behind NAT, the interface might benefit from having a persistent keepalive interval of 25 seconds. If unset or set to 0, it is turned off
- `protocol` (String) Type of configuration entry in an SDN Fabric section config
- `redistribute` (List of String)
- `route_filter` (String) A prefix list that should be used for filtering routes that are to be installed into the kernel routing table


<a id="nestedatt--index"></a>
### Nested Schema for `index`

Read-Only:

- `subdir` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_ips` (List of String) A list of IPs that are routable via this node in the WireGuard fabric.
- `digest` (String) Prevent changes if current configuration file has a different digest. This can be used to prevent concurrent modifications.
- `endpoint` (String) The endpoint used for connecting to this node.
- `fabric_id` (String) Identifier for SDN fabrics
- `interfaces` (List of String)
- `ip` (String) IPv4 address for this node
- `ip6` (String) IPv6 address for this node
- `lock_token` (String) the token for unlocking the global SDN configuration
- `node_id` (String) Identifier for nodes in an SDN fabric
- `peers` (List of String)
- `protocol` (String) Type of configuration entry in an SDN Fabric section config
- `public_key` (String) The public key for the external node.
- `role` (String) The role of this node in the WireGuard fabric.
